result.explanation: Apply the lease transition rule to each event: advance time first, then expire any lease whose deadline is reached. Acquiring requires vacancy; renewing and releasing require the current owner and generation. Generation increases only on successful acquisition and never resets.
result.mapping: config.ttl maps to lease duration; state stores now, owner, generation, and expires. The current event maps to one transition, and output mirrors the resulting observable state plus its status.
result.assumptions: All inputs satisfy the stated schema and safe-integer constraints. Applicability is universal because the implementation directly follows the specified finite-state semantics.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var t=0,o=null,g=0,x=null,L=input.config.ttl;for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],s;if(e.type==='advance'){t+=e.dt;s='advanced'}else{s='ignored';if(x!==null&&x<=t){o=null;x=null}if(e.type==='acquire'){if(o===null){g++;o=e.owner;x=t+L;s='acquired'}else s='busy'}else if(e.type==='renew'){if(o!==null&&o===e.owner&&g===e.generation){x=t+L;s='renewed'}}else if(e.type==='release'){if(o!==null&&o===e.owner&&g===e.generation){o=null;x=null;s='released'}}}var q=output[i];if(!q||q.status!==s||q.now!==t||q.owner!==o||q.generation!==g||q.expires!==x)return false}return true}
